summary: Converts cube map, equirectangular, fish-eye, or dual-paraboloid imagery between projection formats for dome, spherical, and cube-map workflows.
common_gotchas: Equirectangular output should normally use a 2:1 aspect ratio.
Fish-eye output is normally square, with image data inside the circle and corners black.
For better antialiasing, render or convert at a larger resolution and downsample with high-quality resize.
Official docs list multiple input menu items while also warning that cube map is the only input option in some wording.
key_concepts: Converts between cube map, equirectangular, fish-eye, and dual-paraboloid projections.
Equirectangular output maps longitude/latitude across a 2:1 image.
Fish-eye output is normally square with valid image data inside a circle and black corners.
Projection output samples once per output pixel; high-quality antialiasing comes from oversize conversion and downsampling.
